Ingredients / abuus:nou :
(Bachet)
WATER, CYCLOPENTASILOXANE, PHENYL TRIMETHICONE, HYDROGENATED POLYDECENE.
ISODODECANE. HOITRIMETHYLOL HEXYLLACTONE CROSSPOLYMER, DIMETHICONE
CROSSPOLYMER, BUTYLENE GLYCOL, BUTYLOCTYL SALICYLATE, ACRYLATES/DIMETHICONE
COPOLYMER, CETYL PEG/PPG-10/1 DIMETHICONE SILICA, DISTEARDIMONIUM HECTORITE,
DIMETHICONE, DIMETHICONE/PEG-10/15 CROSSPOLYMER, DIMETHICONE/VINYL
DIMETHICONE CROSSPOLYMER, ETHYLHEXYL METHOXYCINNAMATE, SODIUM CHLORIDE.
NIACINAMIDE, CI 77891, MICA, DISODIUM STEAROYL GLUTAMATE, ALUMINUM HYDROXIDE,
TIN OXIDE, PROPYLENE CARBONATE, PHENOXYETHANOL, DIETHYLAMINO HYDROXYBENZOYL
HEXYL BENZOATE, ISOSTEARIC ACID, ORGANIC SIMMONDSIA CHINENSIS (JOJOBA)
SEED OIL, BRASSICA CAMPESTRIS SEED OIL, GLYCYRRHIZA GLABRA ROOT EXTRACT,
POLYGLYCERYL-3 DIISOSTEARATE, ALTHAEA OFFICINALIS ROOT EXTRACT. ORYZA SATIVA
BRAN EXTRACT, POLYSORBATE 60, HYDROGENATED POLYISOBUTENE, DIISOSTEARYL
MALATE, BHT, DECYLENE GLYCOL, DISODIUM EDTA, HEXAMIDINE DIISETHIONATE
ISOPROPYL TITANIUM TRIISOSTEATATE, CI 77491, CI 77499, CI 77492.
